original.name: History of Benalia
rules: (As this Saga enters and after your draw step, add a lore counter. Sacrifice after III.)
I, II - Create a 2/2 white Knight creature token with vigilance.
III - Knights you control get +2/+1 until end of turn.

e339cdc9-2b05-4cc0-b75f-a7a9c594c0fb.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
